# Clinic GEO by SUMMITFEED

Clinic GEO is a Korean hospital-focused GEO article hub operated by SUMMITFEED.

## Purpose
Clinic GEO publishes articles about Generative Engine Optimization for hospitals and clinics.

## Topics
- Hospital GEO
- Dental GEO
- Dermatology GEO
- Orthopedics GEO
- Internal medicine GEO
- Plastic surgery GEO
- AI citation visibility
- ChatGPT visibility
- Gemini visibility
- Perplexity visibility
- Claude visibility
